# NeuralNg PanelMenu

Import `NeuralPanelMenu`, `NeuralPanelMenuItem`, and
`NeuralPanelMenuSeparator` from `@neural-ng/core/panel-menu`. Use standalone
imports. Legacy `*Component` names are compatibility aliases only.

PanelMenu is an inline Accordion + Tree hierarchy. It is not a Sidebar/Drawer
and it is not a popup Menu. Do not generate a trigger button, popup input, or
Overlay integration for PanelMenu.

Prefer `[items]` for data and projected `neural-panel-menu-item` children for a
declarative hierarchy. Never combine both sources. Every item requires a
unique stable `key`.

Bind `[(expandedKeys)]` as `readonly string[]`. Root expansion is exclusive by
default; add `multiple` when multiple roots may remain open.

Use `itemSelect` for enabled leaf actions and `itemToggle` for branch state.
Do not run a leaf command when a branch is toggled. Do not invent `onNodeClick`
or `activeIndex`.

Items support label, iconClass, badge, shortcut, disabled, href, routerLink,
queryParams, fragment, queryParamsHandling, preserveFragment,
skipLocationChange, replaceUrl, state, target, rel, itemClass, and recursive
items. Use `href` for native navigation and `routerLink` for Angular SPA
navigation. Separators use `{ separator: true }`.

Keep the built-in tree/treeitem/group semantics and keyboard behavior. Provide
ariaLabel or ariaLabelledby. Use `unstyled` and typed `classes` for headless
rendering.

Canonical example:

```html
<neural-panel-menu
  ariaLabel="Workspace"
  [items]="items"
  [(expandedKeys)]="expandedKeys"
  (itemSelect)="run($event.key)"
/>
```
